scope: Qatar medical discovery — Qatar University College of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Qatar University publishes a General Medicine tuition schedule by semester: QAR 60,000 in Years 2–3, QAR 90,000 in Year 4, and QAR 120,000 in Years 5–6; it states the first-year amount depends on registered courses.

The current undergraduate fee page gives approximate annual Medicine totals for students admitted from Fall 2023, ranging from QAR 46,800 in Year 1 to QAR 133,400 in Year 5 and notes that totals depend on registration.

College of Medicine admission information requires 12 formal years of schooling and an 85% science GPA, alongside stated English and mathematics test thresholds; it says admission is highly competitive.
Qatar University publishes a Fall 2026 undergraduate application timeline including international-applicant visa and health-college test deadlines.
